files.rationale: Both sides renamed ElsaIntegrationsVersion to ElsaExtensionsVersion and moved to multi-targeting, so the only conflict is the version values; kept PR A's newer 3.6.0 preview line because the merge lands on A's 3.6 branch.

Kept PR A's property-based Elsa versions and its extension packages (Http.Webhooks, Secrets, WorkflowContexts) that replace the removed modules, and applied PR B's third-party bumps (CodeBeam.MudBlazor.Extensions 8.2.1, ResxSourceGenerator 25218.8, MudBlazor.Translations 2.4.0, Radzen.Blazor 7.0.6).
PR A removed the whole Agents module in favor of the external extensions package, and PR B's change only renamed the package reference, which A's Directory.Packages.props already covers.
PR B's changes (the @key, the Internal State section and the Default Configuration label) are all already in PR A's version, so A's restructured layout is kept as is.
PR A's version already has both of PR B's changes (the @ref on the log persistence ExpressionEditor and the Localizer["Default"] commit strategy text), so A's restructured layout is kept unchanged.
Kept PR A's move from ISnackbar to IUserMessageService and carried PR B's ShowTransitionDuration = 2000 snackbar option and null! initializers into the merged code.
